critical_code_review_comments: convex/products.ts update mutation requires `name` (not optional) — any partial PATCH-style call must always supply name. Frontend callsite is fine (full form) but worth noting if a future API client wants partial updates.

SupplierStatements sheet groups by `supplier` string from purchases/purchase_returns — if the same supplier is typed with trailing whitespace or different casing it will create duplicate groups. Low priority; main agent may want to normalise supplier name on insert.

Receipt unit labels (src/receipts.ts invoiceReceipt) could not be visually verified on web (BT print is native-only). Code review of the invoiceReceipt change was NOT performed in this iteration — recommend a quick inline check if PDF/receipt rendering is user-visible.
